Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Dela Rosa again presses SC to reverse ruling on ICC arrest warrant

blocks.text: Senator Bato dela Rosa again urges the Supreme Court to reverse its earlier ruling and stop an International Criminal Court arrest warrant against him.

items: PH spotlights South China Sea, ‘fragmenting world’ in ASEAN defense chiefs’ meeting

blocks.text: Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. tells the Association of Southeast Asian Nations or ASEAN, we must not allow our differences to divide us from within.

items: Goodbye, SPNEC: MVP rebrands Leviste’s solar firm, lines up P5-B deal

blocks.text: Tycoon Manny Pangilinan rebrands SP New Energy Corporation or SPNEC to MGEN Renewables Inc.

items: US costs of Iran war rise to over $47B – Pentagon data

blocks.text: Pentagon data reveals the U.S. military spent over $47 billion in the war in Iran.

items: Israeli exit polls show deadlock, setback for Netanyahu
